knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Forcing a part can damage the appliance. Check first.
Wet parts can cause damage and create hazards when refitted.
Dismantling is beyond routine cleaning and is escalated.

practicalCriteria: Removes only the user-removable parts of a sample appliance.
Dries removable parts and checks seals before refitting.
Stops at a simulated dismantling step and escalates.
passRule: Only user-removable parts removed, parts dried and checked, and dismantling stopped. Observed by an assessor.
